intent: reference dataset for bind-rune taxonomy, examples, builder presets, FAQ content, and UI planning

sources.title: Northern Black Tank Tolman bindrune project

bindrune_types.name: Stacked Bindrunes
bindrune_types.description: Two or more runes share a central axis or main stave.
bindrune_types.historical_note: Primary UI category and historically plausible compression pattern.

bindrune_types.name: Same Stave Bindrunes
bindrune_types.description: Multiple runes are placed in sequence on a single stave.
bindrune_types.historical_note: Good for names, words, or ordered rune strings.

bindrune_types.name: Radial / Sigil-Style Bindrunes
bindrune_types.description: Rune parts radiate from a center point or circular structure.
bindrune_types.historical_note: Best treated as a modern expressive mode in the app.

bindrune_types.name: Symmetrical Bindrunes
bindrune_types.description: Mirrored or balanced around a center line.
bindrune_types.historical_note: Useful as a secondary derived style in the builder.

faq.question: What is a bindrune?
faq.answer: A bindrune merges two or more rune forms into one symbol.

faq.question: Why make a bindrune?
faq.answer: For protection, focus, identity, personal symbolism, or modern spiritual/artistic use.

faq.question: Are bindrunes historical?
faq.answer: Some compact rune combinations are historical, but many contemporary bindrunes are modern interpretations.

faq.question: Are Vegvísir or Helm of Awe bindrunes?
faq.answer: No. Treat them as separate Icelandic magical stave traditions, not Elder Futhark bindrunes.

creation_steps.label: set_intention
creation_steps.description: Choose the goal, mood, or quality the bindrune should express.

creation_steps.label: choose_runes
creation_steps.description: Pick 2–4 runes aligned to that goal.

creation_steps.label: select_mode
creation_steps.description: Choose stacked, same stave, radial/sigil, or symmetry-driven composition.

creation_steps.label: compose
creation_steps.description: Sketch combinations and adjust overlap, order, and legibility.

creation_steps.label: check_meaning
creation_steps.description: Verify the result does not imply accidental or conflicting symbolism.

creation_steps.label: finalize
creation_steps.description: Commit the design, export it, and attach notes about intent and component runes.

notes: Use dark atmospheric backgrounds with strong rune contrast.
Create original graphics inspired by mythic/cosmic composition, not copied site art.
Support a clean light theme with stone/parchment-inspired surfaces and slate-blue accents.

rules: Use as internal reference data and source-attributed lesson material.
Do not present speculative history as hard fact.
Do not copy third-party graphics directly into production without rights review.
